request.description: Create an application session token. This method must be called every time the application is launched and requires a Cineplex managed Application Key to be sent in the request. The newly generated session token received from this method is then valid for a period of 24 hours. This method must be called before any other method available. Note that there have been new headers required for device fingerprinting.
